Depth+kernel+epochs already mapped. (2) Failure mode: img_sr=0.02 (BF range/intensity bandwidth INIT) may be too narrow -- the BF only averages near-identical-intensity pixels, limiting streak suppression in smooth breast tissue. (5) BUDGET: same ep10 -> ~120s. (6) Loop continues. Artifacts saved.
